summary: This room is the DSP/synthesis-physics neighborhood — Bessel/Mathieu/Floquet math, the granular-and-particle family (Granular, Neural Granular, Bayesian Granular, Particle Synthesis, Murmuration), the inharmonicity/dispersion cluster, and the pedagogy layer (Objects to Think With, Audition Gate, JSUI, Latent Error). It arrived already densely woven — nearly every pair I checked (Metric Modulation, Dub Lineage, JSUI, Audition Gate, Murmuration, Ohm's Law) had its real cross-links in place, including several that read at first like community-lens finds but turned out to already be covered via a shared hub (Kuramoto Coupling, Frequency-Time Duality). The one clear gap was Objects to Think With's own forward vector, which names itself as under-declared from the instance side: reading its source quotes against the room's project/concept bodies surfaced two entries using its exact diagnostic language ("not as metaphor but as design principles" / "direct structural isomorphism") that hadn't yet declared the relation. I tested and dropped a third candidate (Metric Modulation mirrors Floquet Theory) — the periodicity-reframing resemblance didn't survive a close read of Floquet's actual content (linear ODE solution structure vs. tempo-ratio reinterpretation), so it stayed out as a forced link. No contradictions, no unsung paths (every explicit body-text reference I checked already carries its frontmatter link), no directed flags (room file's directed_flags is empty), and nothing in scope for merges/compost/demotions/health flags per the harness's scope note.

typed_relations.rationale: Objects to Think With's own body quotes this entry as one of the palace's three self-declared isomorphism instances, but Biomechanical Synthesis carries no exemplifies link back — the relation is named in the target's prose and missing on the source's frontmatter.
typed_relations.evidence: Biomechanical Synthesis.md: "treats biological processes as DSP operations — not as metaphor but as design principles. ... Body horror is pedagogy: making DSP mechanics physical makes them unforgettable." / Objects to Think With.md: "[[Biomechanical Synthesis]] say it in their own words (... \"not as metaphor but as design principles\")"

typed_relations.rationale: Not named in Objects to Think With's own text, but Particle Synthesis independently uses the identical diagnostic phrase the OTTW entry treats as its test for a genuine instance (isomorphism, not metaphor) — this is the room-crossing find the folders wouldn't catch since the two entries sit in different Projects/ subfolders and neither currently points at the other.
typed_relations.evidence: Particle Synthesis.md: "This is not metaphor — it is direct structural isomorphism."
